// =============================================================================
// d_ca05 -- miss_handler_arb
//
// Multi-requester cache miss handler.
//
//  * Two request paths, separately arbitrated (F1): uncached single accesses
//    go out on the bypass AXI port, cacheline refills (with eviction of dirty
//    victims) on the data AXI port.
//  * Both arbiters are strict lowest-index priority and starve (F2).
//  * The MSHR match outputs overlap by construction (F3): the index compare
//    is a sub-range of the address compare and the served requester is not
//    excluded.
//  * The flush walk is pinned (F4): every set once, ascending, one read and
//    one write per set, be_o.vldrty on all ways for the write.
//  * Acknowledgement rules F5/F7/F8: a genuine flush acks one cycle; an
//    AMO-induced walk never acks; flush and AMO asserted in the same cycle
//    run the walk and never ack.
//  * An incoming miss defers a pending atomic (F9); atomics are the lowest
//    priority work.
//  * An atomic is an AXI ATOP write on the bypass port; both B and R are
//    consumed and R carries the pre-operation value (A7).
// =============================================================================
module miss_handler_arb
  import miss_handler_arb_pkg::*;
#(
  parameter int unsigned NR_PORTS = 4
) (
  input  logic clk,
  input  logic rst_n,

  input  logic flush_i,
  output logic flush_ack_o,
  output logic miss_o,
  input  logic busy_i,

  input  logic [NR_PORTS-1:0][$bits(miss_req_t)-1:0] miss_req_i,
  output logic [NR_PORTS-1:0]       bypass_gnt_o,
  output logic [NR_PORTS-1:0]       bypass_valid_o,
  output logic [NR_PORTS-1:0][63:0] bypass_data_o,
  output logic [NR_PORTS-1:0]       miss_gnt_o,
  output logic [NR_PORTS-1:0]       active_serving_o,
  output logic [63:0]               critical_word_o,
  output logic                      critical_word_valid_o,

  input  logic [NR_PORTS-1:0][55:0] mshr_addr_i,
  output logic [NR_PORTS-1:0]       mshr_addr_matches_o,
  output logic [NR_PORTS-1:0]       mshr_index_matches_o,

  input  amo_req_t  amo_req_i,
  output amo_resp_t amo_resp_o,

  output axi_req_t axi_bypass_req_o,
  input  axi_rsp_t axi_bypass_rsp_i,

  output axi_req_t axi_data_req_o,
  input  axi_rsp_t axi_data_rsp_i,

  output logic [SET_ASSOC-1:0]        req_o,
  output logic [INDEX_WIDTH-1:0]      addr_o,
  output cache_line_t                 data_o,
  output cl_be_t                      be_o,
  input  cache_line_t [SET_ASSOC-1:0] data_i,
  output logic                        we_o
);

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // internal types
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  typedef enum logic [3:0] {
    S_IDLE,
    S_FLUSH,       // F4 walk
    S_AMO_ISSUE,   // A7 ATOP write issue
    S_AMO_RESP,    // A7 wait for B and R
    S_VICTIM,      // read data of the set available, pick victim
    S_WB_ISSUE,    // evict dirty victim
    S_WB_WAIT_B,
    S_REFILL_ISSUE,
    S_REFILL_DATA,
    S_REFILL_STORE
  } state_e;

  typedef enum logic [1:0] {
    BP_IDLE,
    BP_REQ,      // issue AR, or AW + W
    BP_WAIT_R,
    BP_WAIT_B
  } bp_state_e;

  localparam int unsigned PORT_SEL_W = (NR_PORTS > 1) ? $clog2(NR_PORTS) : 1;

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // helpers
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  // Map a RISC-V-style AMO onto the AXI ATOP encoding (A7).  The fetch-type
  // operations follow the AMBA AXI5 ATOP table; AMO_AND maps onto ATOP CLR with
  // the operand inverted (old & b == old & ~(~b)).
  function automatic logic [5:0] amo_to_atop(input amo_t op);
    case (op)
      AMO_SWAP: amo_to_atop = 6'b01_0000;  // AtomicSwap SWAP
      AMO_ADD:  amo_to_atop = 6'b11_0000;  // AtomicFetch ADD
      AMO_XOR:  amo_to_atop = 6'b11_0010;  // AtomicFetch EOR
      AMO_OR:   amo_to_atop = 6'b11_0011;  // AtomicFetch SET
      AMO_AND:  amo_to_atop = 6'b11_0001;  // AtomicFetch CLR
      AMO_MAX:  amo_to_atop = 6'b11_0100;  // AtomicFetch SMAX
      AMO_MIN:  amo_to_atop = 6'b11_0101;  // AtomicFetch SMIN
      AMO_MAXU: amo_to_atop = 6'b11_0110;  // AtomicFetch UMAX
      AMO_MINU: amo_to_atop = 6'b11_0111;  // AtomicFetch UMIN
      AMO_CAS1: amo_to_atop = 6'b10_0001;  // AtomicCompare, smaller
      AMO_CAS2: amo_to_atop = 6'b10_0010;  // AtomicCompare, larger
      default:  amo_to_atop = 6'b00_0000;
    endcase
  endfunction

  // byte-enable mask of an access of `size` bytes at lane offset `addr_lo`
  function automatic logic [7:0] size_strb(input logic [1:0] size, input logic [2:0] addr_lo);
    case (size)
      2'b00:   size_strb = 8'b0000_0001 << addr_lo;
      2'b01:   size_strb = 8'b0000_0011 << addr_lo;
      2'b10:   size_strb = 8'b0000_1111 << addr_lo;
      default: size_strb = 8'b1111_1111;
    endcase
  endfunction

  ...

// =============================================================================
// d_ca05 -- miss_handler_arb : multi-requester cache miss handler
// =============================================================================
// Design notes (clause references in comments):
//   * Two request paths, separately arbitrated (F1): bypass (uncached single
//     accesses, and atomics) on axi_bypass_*, cacheline refills and evictions
//     on axi_data_*.
//   * Both arbiters are strict lowest-index priority and starve (F2).
//   * MSHR match outputs overlap by construction (F3): the index compare is a
//     sub-range of the address compare, and the port being served is not
//     excluded from either output.
//   * The flush walk is pinned (F4): 256 sets ascending, one read and one
//     write per set, be_o.vldrty on all 8 ways for every write -- 512 array
//     requests, 256 of them writes.
//   * Acknowledgement (F5/F7/F8): a walk started by flush_i alone acks for one
//     cycle; a walk started for an atomic never acks; flush_i and
//     amo_req_i.req in the same cycle run the walk and never ack.
//   * A non-bypass miss raised in the same cycle as an atomic wins (F9); the
//     atomic is re-evaluated afresh afterwards.
//   * An atomic is an AXI ATOP write on the bypass port consuming both B and
//     R; R carries the pre-operation value (A7).
//   * busy_i gates entry to both walks but not miss handling (A4).
// =============================================================================
module miss_handler_arb
  import miss_handler_arb_pkg::*;
#(
  parameter int unsigned NR_PORTS = 4
) (
  input  logic clk,
  input  logic rst_n,

  input  logic flush_i,
  output logic flush_ack_o,
  output logic miss_o,
  input  logic busy_i,

  input  logic [NR_PORTS-1:0][$bits(miss_req_t)-1:0] miss_req_i,
  output logic [NR_PORTS-1:0]       bypass_gnt_o,
  output logic [NR_PORTS-1:0]       bypass_valid_o,
  output logic [NR_PORTS-1:0][63:0] bypass_data_o,
  output logic [NR_PORTS-1:0]       miss_gnt_o,
  output logic [NR_PORTS-1:0]       active_serving_o,
  output logic [63:0]               critical_word_o,
  output logic                      critical_word_valid_o,

  input  logic [NR_PORTS-1:0][55:0] mshr_addr_i,
  output logic [NR_PORTS-1:0]       mshr_addr_matches_o,
  output logic [NR_PORTS-1:0]       mshr_index_matches_o,

  input  amo_req_t  amo_req_i,
  output amo_resp_t amo_resp_o,

  output axi_req_t axi_bypass_req_o,
  input  axi_rsp_t axi_bypass_rsp_i,

  output axi_req_t axi_data_req_o,
  input  axi_rsp_t axi_data_rsp_i,

  output logic [SET_ASSOC-1:0]        req_o,
  output logic [INDEX_WIDTH-1:0]      addr_o,
  output cache_line_t                 data_o,
  output cl_be_t                      be_o,
  input  cache_line_t [SET_ASSOC-1:0] data_i,
  output logic                        we_o
);

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // internal types
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  typedef enum logic [3:0] {
    S_IDLE,
    S_FLUSH,        // F4 invalidate walk
    S_AMO_ISSUE,    // A7 ATOP write issue
    S_AMO_RESP,     // A7 consume B and R
    S_VICTIM,       // set read data available, pick victim way
    S_WB_ISSUE,     // evict a dirty victim (AW + 2 W beats)
    S_WB_WAIT_B,
    S_REFILL_ISSUE, // AR for the line
    S_REFILL_DATA,  // 2 R beats
    S_REFILL_STORE  // write the line into the array
  } state_e;

  typedef enum logic [1:0] {
    BP_IDLE,
    BP_REQ,      // issue AR, or AW + single W beat
    BP_WAIT_R,
    BP_WAIT_B
  } bp_state_e;

  localparam int unsigned PORT_SEL_W = (NR_PORTS > 1) ? $clog2(NR_PORTS) : 1;

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // helpers
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // RISC-V AMO -> AXI ATOP (A7).  Fetch-type operations follow the AMBA AX5
  // ATOP operation table; AMO_AND maps to AtomicFetch CLR with the operand
  // inverted (old & b == old & ~(~b)).
  function automatic logic [5:0] amo_to_atop(input amo_t op);
    case (op)
      AMO_SWAP: amo_to_atop = 6'b01_0000;
      AMO_ADD:  amo_to_atop = 6'b11_0000;
      AMO_XOR:  amo_to_atop = 6'b11_0010;
      AMO_OR:   amo_to_atop = 6'b11_0011;
      AMO_AND:  amo_to_atop = 6'b11_0001;
      AMO_MAX:  amo_to_atop = 6'b11_0100;
      AMO_MIN:  amo_to_atop = 6'b11_0101;
      AMO_MAXU: amo_to_atop = 6'b11_0110;
      AMO_MINU: amo_to_atop = 6'b11_0111;
      AMO_CAS1: amo_to_atop = 6'b10_0001;
      AMO_CAS2: amo_to_atop = 6'b10_0010;
      default:  amo_to_atop = 6'b00_0000;
    endcase
  endfunction

  // byte lanes covered by an access of 2**size bytes at lane offset addr_lo
  function automatic logic [7:0] size_strb(input logic [1:0] size, input logic [2:0] addr_lo);
    case (size)
      2'b00:   size_strb = 8'b0000_0001 << addr_lo;
      2'b01:   size_strb = 8'b0000_0011 << addr_lo;
      2'b10:   size_strb = 8'b0000_1111 << addr_lo;
      default: size_strb = 8'b1111_1111;
    endcase
  endfunction

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // state
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  state_e    state_q, state_d;
  bp_state_e bp_state_q, bp_state_d;

  logic [8:0] flush_cnt_q, flush_cnt_d;  // 512 array accesses per walk
  logic       ack_flush_q, ack_flush_d;  // F5/F7/F8: may this walk ack?
  logic       flush_ack_q, flush_ack_d;

  logic                  mshr_valid_q, mshr_valid_d;
  logic [55:0]           mshr_addr_q, mshr_addr_d;
  logic [PORT_SEL_W-1:0] mshr_port_q, mshr_port_d;

  logic [SET_ASSOC-1:0]  victim_way_q, victim_way_d;
  logic                  victim_dirty_q, victim_dirty_d;
  logic [TAG_WIDTH-1:0]  victim_tag_q, victim_tag_d;
  logic [LINE_WIDTH-1:0] victim_data_q, victim_data_d;
  logic [2:0]            rr_cnt_q, rr_cnt_d;

  logic [LINE_WIDTH-1:0] line_q, line_d;
